section_summary: This section comprises confidential intelligence dossiers and service records compiled on senior officers of the Imperial Japanese Navy, arranged alphabetically from surnames beginning with O through Y. Each individual record details promotion histories, sea and shore assignments, court ranks, decorations, and analytical estimates of personal character, strategic outlook, and foreign attitudes, featuring key commanders such as Koshiro Oikawa, Shigetaro Shimada, Isoroku Yamamoto, Mitsumasa Yonai, and Zengo Yoshida. The section concludes with a Department of State cross-reference file note dated September 30, 1941, regarding Japanese commanders and staff stationed at Shanghai.

subfiles.about: Biographical sketches, service records, and intelligence evaluations of senior Imperial Japanese Navy officers with surnames beginning with O through Y.
subfiles.summary: Confidential intelligence records detailing biographical data, promotion timelines, service postings, and character evaluations for Japanese naval flag officers and captains alphabetically from Oikawa to Yoshida. Prominent figures analyzed include Admirals Koshiro Oikawa, Shigetaro Shimada, Koichi Shiozawa, Isoroku Yamamoto, Mitsumasa Yonai, and Zengo Yoshida. The reports assess each officer's personality, political inclinations, strategic viewpoints, aviation or submarine expertise, and attitudes toward the United States and Great Britain.
subfiles.title: Japanese Navy Personnel: Characteristics - Individual (Oikawa to Yoshida)

subfiles.about: Cross-reference note indexing a September 30, 1941 communication from the Naval Attaché regarding Japanese commanders and staff in Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference file note referring to a Naval Attaché communication concerning Japanese commanders and staff stationed at Shanghai.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference File Note: Japanese Commanders and Staff stationed at Shanghai
